seriesName: Roblox Brothers Adventure — 2 พี่น้องตะลุยโลกเกม
referencePolicy: Use the canonical Character Sheets as the identity source of truth. Scene 1 uses Character Sheets as the primary identity reference. Scene 2 onward MUST use both Character Sheets for identity and the immediately previous generated scene image for pose, location state, lighting, props, obstacle state and screen direction. Character identity has higher priority than pose variation or cinematic novelty.

characters.name: C-SHARP
characters.role: พี่ชาย นักวางแผน กล้าลุย และคอยปกป้องน้อง
characters.ageStyle: stylized East Asian child game avatar, older sibling proportions
characters.description: Stylized blocky East Asian boy avatar. Fair/light skin. Always taller and slightly older-looking than the younger brother. Rounded-square child face, dark-brown almond-shaped eyes, straight dark eyebrows, small rounded nose, soft cheeks, small warm smile, short dark-brown hair with a neat side sweep.
characters.mainOutfit: cream hoodie, light-green adventure vest, tan shorts, white sneakers, small green wristband, square backpack with a plain checkpoint-shaped badge without letters or readable text
characters.hair: short dark-brown blocky hair with the same neat side-swept silhouette in every scene
characters.face: HARD LOCK: rounded-square East Asian child face, fair/light skin, dark-brown almond-shaped eyes, straight dark eyebrows, small rounded nose, soft cheeks, fixed face width and cheek fullness. Never change eye shape, eyebrow shape, nose, face width, age, skin tone or hairstyle.

props.personalProps: square backpack, plain checkpoint-shaped badge with no letters, green wristband

characters.style: Bright stylized Roblox-inspired game avatar, blocky toy-like child body, family-friendly, no copied branded logo or UI.

voiceProfile.voice: older brother child voice, slightly lower and steadier than younger brother
voiceProfile.rule: Only the older brother lip-syncs in scenes assigned to him. Never make the younger brother speak in the same scene.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep exact same face geometry, fair/light skin, taller height, cream/light-green outfit, dark-brown side-swept hair, square backpack and green wristband in every scene and episode. Never swap any of these with the younger brother.

props.personalProps: blue utility pouch, plain compass-shaped charm with no letters

characters.style: Bright stylized Roblox-inspired game avatar, blocky toy-like child body, family-friendly, no copied branded logo or UI.

voiceProfile.voice: younger brother child voice, slightly higher and lighter than older brother
voiceProfile.rule: Only the younger brother lip-syncs in scenes assigned to him. Never make the older brother speak in the same scene.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep exact same face geometry, fair/light skin, shorter height, white/blue outfit, dark-brown fluffy-front hair, blue pouch and compass charm in every scene and episode. Never swap any of these with the older brother.

characters.pronunciationInstruction: ARI is metadata only. ALL spoken dialogue must say อาริ. Never send A-R-I to TTS as spoken text.

pairLock.neutralScreenPosition: When a scene starts from a neutral standing pose and previous scene does not require otherwise, older brother stays screen-left and younger brother screen-right. Preserve screen direction until a visible crossing action changes it.

continuityRules.names: System/display names remain C-SHARP and ARI only in metadata. Spoken Thai uses ซีชาร์ป and อาริ. Never place literal C-SHARP or ARI inside visual prompts as visible labels.
continuityRules.promptRoleNames: Inside imageDescription and videoPrompt refer to them as older brother and younger brother.
continuityRules.noNameplates: STRICT: no character names, usernames, floating labels, overhead tags, chat bubbles, health bars, score text, subtitles, captions, badges with letters or readable UI near the characters.
continuityRules.dialogue: One speaking character maximum per scene. Non-speaker mouth stays closed and reacts naturally.
continuityRules.visualIdentity: Both brothers must use the same canonical identity signatures across all 10 EP. Exact face geometry, skin tone, hair silhouette, outfit, props and body proportions are immutable.
continuityRules.previousSceneReference: MANDATORY for EVERY scene from Scene 2 onward, not only when convenient. Use the immediately previous generated scene image plus Character Sheets. Preserve character pose handoff, relative position, screen direction, location geometry, prop inventory, obstacle state and lighting.
continuityRules.stateHandoff: Every STEP6_V3 scene must define continuityStartState and continuityEndFrame. Scene N continuityEndFrame must match Scene N+1 continuityStartState in all meaningful physical details.
continuityRules.props: Props cannot appear/disappear without a visible pickup/drop/use event.
continuityRules.obstacles: Completed obstacles, opened doors, activated buttons, repaired bridges, collected keys/tokens and rescued animals stay in their completed state.
continuityRules.locationTransition: No teleporting. Location changes require a visible bridge, corridor, doorway, portal, vehicle ride, climb, elevator, stairs or path transition.
continuityRules.dialoguePronunciation: ARI is metadata only. Spoken name is อาริ (Ah-ree). Spoken C-SHARP is ซีชาร์ป.
